localizedValue.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference: Hanoi Cooking Class with Local Market Tour
Join a market tour and cooking class in Hanoi. Enjoy fresh ingredients & traditional food.
Hanoi: Traditional Cooking Class & Market Tour
Learn four authentic recipes and make egg coffee.
Hanoi Cooking Class & Coffee Tasting Delights
Join a hands-on Hanoi cooking class with market tour, home-style meal, and free wine. End with a tasting of Vietnam’s salted, egg, or coconut coffee. $1 from each guest supports charity meals.
Learn how to make  phở and bún chả  with chef
Located in the Old Quarter, this well-organized class, taught by a chef with over 10 years of experience, will give you authentic experiences and equip you with cutting, slicing, and cooking skills.
Unique Vietnamese Coffee Class - Afternoon Class
Learn the art of brewing traditional Vietnamese coffee.
N Y N A Coffee - Egg Coffee/Coconut/Salted Coffee

“Join NYNA’s coffee-making class to explore the history and culture of Vietnamese coffee and experience the art of crafting Egg Coffee, Coconut Coffee, and Salted Coffee – signature flavors of Vietnam
Hanoi Transfer to or from Sa Pa VIP Sleeper Bus
Travel in comfort between Hanoi and Sa Pa with this sleeper bus transfer service. Sit back, relax, and simplify your travel plans with this pre-booked transfer either to or from Sa Pa.
Toitoi - Learn Hanoi's culinary secrets
Learn Hanoi’s culinary traditions with a market tour and cooking class.
N Y N A Coffee - Egg Coffee/Coconut/Salted Coffee

“Join NYNA’s coffee-making class to explore the history and culture of Vietnamese coffee and experience the art of crafting Egg Coffee, Coconut Coffee, and Salted Coffee – signature flavors of Vietnam
Authentic Hanoi Tofu Making & Local Living
Join a local family to make traditional tofu, enjoy fresh tofu and warm soy milk, and experience authentic Vietnamese village life through a simple, low-waste tradition. Solo travelers are welcome.
Cook Like a Local - Hanoi Cooking Class
Shop, dine, and drink as the locals do as you visit a wet market, make traditional dishes from scratch, sip rice wine, and finish with a famed egg coffee (Vegan/ vegetarian menu are available).
Hanoi: Taste Vietnamese Egg, Salt & Coconut Coffee
Immerse in Vietnam’s coffee culture with 6 iconic brews, from bean to cup. Enjoy hands-on brewing with free vegan-friendly customization. Choose your preferred workshop language: English or Mandarin.
Vietnamese Home Cooking with a Food Stylist
This class is perfect for those seeking an authentic home cooking experience. You’ll be welcomed into my home to cook and share the meal together. We work as a team, just like in a family kitchen.
Cooking class with market tour & Pho from scratch

Cook in a peaceful garden 
Make fresh pho noodles by hand from scratch Visit a local market and learn about Vietnamese ingredients
Cook 4 dishes, Bun Cha, Spring Rolls & Banh Xeo
Ninh Binh Hoa Lu, Trang An & Mua Cave Tour
Discover Ninh Binh in one day: explore Hoa Lu, cycle through peaceful villages, enjoy a local buffet, cruise Trang An by sampan, hike Mua Cave Peak, then return to Hanoi.
Unique Vietnamese Coffee Class - Morning Class
Learn to create three different varieties of local coffee with the help of a cafe owner.
One hour in Hanoi: Make Egg, Coconut & Salt Coffee
Learn the fascinating story of coffee in Vietnam and how it became a big part of their culture. You’ll learn to brew three different Vietnamese coffees yourself: egg, coconut and salt coffee.
Vietnamese Coffee Workshop – Brew & Board Games
Join NYNA in Hanoi to explore coffee culture. Brew phin coffee, make Egg Coffee, enjoy tastings, and relax with fun board games in a cozy local café setting.
4-Day 3-Night Ha Giang Loop Motorbike experience
Embark on a motorbike adventure across Ha Giang's mountains, villages and epic passes. In four days, you'll hit top viewpoints, ride the Nho Que River, and experience authentic local culture
1-hour Coffee Workshop with Snack & Wine Tasting

Join an interactive 1-hour coffee workshop where you’ll learn to make one of Vietnam’s signature drinks: Egg, Coconut, or Salt Coffee. A perfect hands-on experience to explore local Vietnamese flavors
Make 6 signature Viet Coffees at Hanoi Local Cafe
A full-sensory coffee experience that goes beyond the cup, rich with cultural depth, insider tips, and your own creative flair. Bring home not just the memories and recipes.
Cook Hanoi cuisine with a local chef
Pick fresh ingredients at a local market, then transform them into Vietnamese dishes.
Hanoi: Vietnamese mooncake workshop & tea tasting

Learn to make traditional Vietnamese Mooncake: baked mooncake and snow skin mooncake
Taste 3 popular Vietnamese teas paired with mooncake
Discover the cultural meaning of the Mid-Autumn Festival in VN
Make Hanoi’s famous Egg Coffee
Enjoy a hands-on class making Hanoi’s unique Egg Coffee.
Vietnamese Coffee Workshop – Brew & Board Games
Experience Hanoi’s coffee culture with NYNA. Brew traditional phin coffee, make Egg & Coconut Coffee, enjoy tastings, and relax with fun board games in a cozy local café.
Hanoi Tea Workshop: Craft 3 Local Tea & 9 Tastings
Discover the heart of Vietnamese beverage culture through hands-on brewing, authentic local stories, and 9 tastings featuring signature teas, local coffees, and traditional fruit liqueurs.
Ha Long Bay 1-Day Experience Cruise and Kayak
Cruise through stunning Ha Long Bay, explore Surprise Cave, swim at Titov Island, kayak at Luon Cave, enjoy lunch onboard and relax with sunset views, wine, snacks and fresh fruit.
Hanoi 6 Coffee Types Workshop & Hidden City Tour
Experience the hidden charm of Hanoi through a hands-on 6 types of Vietnamese coffee workshop and a local hidden gem city tour beyond the usual tourist spots.
Hanoi: Craft 5 Banh Mi Fillings & Fresh Green Tea
Unlocks the secrets of Vietnam's iconic street food! Craft authentic pâté, pickle, signature sauces, and cloud eggs. End with a Heritage Tea Ceremony & dive into local culinary culture in 3.5 hours.
Bake bánh mì and brew Hanoi coffee
Knead dough, bake your baguette, and craft a signature Hanoi coffee. Savor your creations while hearing family recipes from a chef and bánh mì expert.
Hanoi: Make Floating Cake & Taste Fresh Lotus Tea
Escape to a hidden garden villa and craft special Vietnamese floating cạke called Bánh Trôi, then unwind with a premium West Lake lotus tea ceremony while discovering stories of Vietnamese heritage.
Hanoi Latte Coffee Workshop with Espresso Machines
Join my coffee workshop where you’ll experience the daily workflow of a professional café barista with. Learn espresso brewing, milk steaming, and basic latte art with local coffee experts.
Hanoi Coffee Journey – Egg Coffee and Chill
Experience Hanoi’s coffee culture with NYNA. Brew traditional phin coffee, make Egg & Coconut Coffee, enjoy tastings, and relax with fun board games in a cozy local café.
Banh Mi Cooking Experience - ToiToi VietNam

Discover the cultural story behind Vietnamese Banh Mi
Explore the essential components of a traditional Banh Mi
Prepare classic fillings: BBQ pork, vegetables, fresh herbs
Enjoy your own bread.
Hanoi: Traditional Food Hands-on & Tea Culture
Enjoy your choice of *Phở* or *Bún Chả*, paired with Vietnamese fresh green tea. Discover authentic Hanoi flavors and tea culture, with complimentary pick-up and drop-off within Hanoi Old Quarter.
